identity.narrative: Open-source Sharp MZ emulator with cycle-accurate Z80A execution, chip/peripheral emulation, a built-in debugger and an MCP bridge exposing screenshots, coverage, profiling and analysis controls. Primary docs provide Linux, Windows and macOS build paths; no minimum host CPU or RAM is stated. Claude client configuration documents a supported integration, not evidence that AI authored the project. Current main saves hidden Z80 MEMPTR, interrupt, EI-delay and T-state state plus CTC, scroll, VRAM-wait and floppy-controller state; it safely adapts RAMdisk/IDE8 snapshot loads. Debugger/MCP fixes expose all 532 expanded memory regions, keep debugger reads from firing guest watchpoints, correctly stop temporary run-to breakpoints and record the instruction bytes actually fetched by self-modifying code. Matching MCP tools expose searches and freezes for automation, and the same change fixes the missing second half of PEHU 512 KiB memory. A maintained locale catalog at the reviewed commit explicitly names Claude Code as Last-Translator, correcting the prior no-evidence AI audit while keeping attribution limited to that content. The release adds ZZ9000 AHI/SANA-II/SDK/MHI/MPEGA/image/ZZPlay support, optional external MiniGL and dma-buf paths, relative media paths, cartridge and .A1000 ROM handling, runtime GL fallback, Raspberry Pi 4 drawing improvements, ARM64 JIT fixes, FreeBSD amd64/aarch64 CI and broad networking/display/input/libretro/Android corrections. m68k remains the guest CPU; ARM/x86/RISC-V/LoongArch are host families, not guest minima. External Kickstart ROMs and game media remain outside the GPL source grant. No independent execution or equivalence test was performed. These are source-level fixes on current main, not a new published release or independently executed verification. Evidence: https://github.com/BlitterStudio/amiberry/commit/71ac39e07d339d9d8e296e15db79642e6ab5619a https://github.com/BlitterStudio/amiberry/commit/3b5e647578e667adff3a88ef9557e2f3702b8ebe https://github.com/BlitterStudio/amiberry/commit/bdc870008140cff3dbbb4379df94aa92d7322e27 Current main ports WinUAE's optional loopback GDB remote server, disabled by default and unavailable with the threaded CPU, with m68k registers, physical RAM/ROM, stepping, breakpoints, watchpoints and memory-map support. Evidence: https://github.com/BlitterStudio/amiberry/commit/4faddbe399757a663fb3f2e8dc4be678eda96d4d https://github.com/BlitterStudio/amiberry/commit/831f13e71ee6e872d6d3570f2c23068493d0dd15 Development head now honors database-requested 68040 AGA configurations, disables cycle-exact mode when requested, aligns Android previews with the launched CPU/FPU configuration and follows with 68030 database handling. These guest CPU selections are emulated configurations, not Amiberry host target CPUs or minimum machines. No tracker-side WHDLoad or IPC run was performed. classification.narrative: The configuration work remains system-emulator interface and state-management development; it does not change guest or host CPU classification.

source_cpu.narrative: src/newcpu.cpp explicitly identifies MC68000 emulation and contains 68020/030/040/060 cache/MMU state. m68k is the emulated guest family, distinct from the host CPU families.

target_cpu.narrative: README explicitly names ARM, x86, RISC-V and LoongArch64 host hardware and ARM64/x86-64 JIT paths. Broad family values preserve these direct claims without inferring host minimums from C++ or OS names.

build.narrative: Development head adds LOAD_CONFIG and SAVE_CONFIG actions across IPC and Swift, preserves pending configuration when file reads fail, avoids autosave description renames, and resolves named files in the configuration directory before checks.
build.limitations: This is source-level development evidence, not a new release or tracker-side emulator run.

runtime_profiles.narrative: The configuration actions state no new host CPU, RAM or OS minimum; the existing v8.4.2 glibc 2.35 AppImage requirement remains unchanged.

ai.narrative: Existing Claude and ChatGPT evidence remains; the keyboard-reset fix additionally has an explicit Copilot co-author trailer. Attribution is scoped to evidenced commits.

relationships.narrative: General-purpose Amiga machine emulator built on the UAE/WinUAE core, eligible as system emulation rather than a single-game emulator. Amiga is the emulated source machine, not a claim that the emulator runs natively on a classic Amiga. Host ARM/x86/RISC-V/LoongArch claims do not redefine the guest CPU. Individual model/chipset/ROM combinations were not tested. GPL-3.0 source does not license external Kickstart ROMs, game disks or bundled third-party components. Repository metadata is not marked as a GitHub fork, but this does not erase explicit code/asset ancestry. Root-normalized dedup and prior-root screening passed the 1498-project baseline.
